name: kul-ve-taht
description: Kul ve Taht - metin tabanli, kalici ortak dunyali ortacag-fantezi RPG/strateji (0 TL butce)

scripts.build: npm run sync:assets && npm run build -w @kvt/app && npm run build -w @kvt/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kvt/app && npm run typecheck -w @kvt/functions
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:paid
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply kul-ve-taht-db --local --config functions/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply kul-ve-taht-db --remote --config functions/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w @kvt/app && wrangler pages deploy app/dist --project-name kul-ve-taht
